scope: Planning for one's own incapacity and being made the subject of an order: Part 9 (ss 104, 104B, 104C, 105, 106, 107, 108, 109; Schedule 3 Forms 1-2), Part 9A (ss 110B-110H, 110N; regs 6, 8, Schedule 1), Part 9B (ss 110P-110T; regs 7-9, Schedule 2), s 110ZD (person responsible), s 110ZJ and s 119 (orders of priority), s 45 (functions borrowed by s 110G), ss 53(a), 54 (via s 110H), s 4(3)-(4), s 43 (guardianship order) and s 64 (administration order). Out: the Tribunal's procedure, reviews and appeals; limited guardians' and administrators' functions; sterilisation; the Public Advocate; recognition of other jurisdictions' instruments; urgent treatment; abortion; medical research.
seat: the adult planning for incapacity (the donor of an enduring power of attorney, the appointor of an enduring guardian, the maker of an advance health directive) and the person for whom a guardian or administrator may be appointed
